title: The Shan Mission
author: Rev. Josiah Nelson Cushing
description: Historical field account by Rev. J. N. Cushing documenting the creation of the first movable metal fonts for Lik Tai script, lexicographical fieldwork in the Shan States, and linguistic connections with Tai communities across Upper Burma and Assam.
